Intent: diagnose why codex third-party endpoint support stopped working on this machine and restore it. The user then approved two follow-up actions via AskUserQuestion: deleting the dead `codex` provider entry from endpoints.yaml ("删掉（推荐）") and restarting trellis prod immediately ("现在重启（推荐）").

   - `@smokingmouse/agent@0.5.1` SDK CodexBackend: spawns `codex exec --json`; `resolveCodexModel(model)` resolves model against endpoints.yaml (protocol "openai")

   - Login gate: passthrough mode runs `codex login status`; non-zero exit → the reported error. False-negative on machines whose global ~/.codex/config.toml has static-key providers (requires_openai_auth=false)
   - endpoints.yaml search order: `$SM_ENDPOINTS_PATH` → `~/.config/sm/endpoints.yaml` (canonical) → `~/.claude/global/endpoints.yaml` (legacy). SDK caches yaml in-process (`_cached`); `clearEndpointsCache()` exists; prod restart required after yaml edit
   - resolveEndpoint matching: provider-qualified id → exact model match (providers in yaml order) → provider name → prefix match. `toEndpointConfig` throws if preferProtocol="openai" but provider only has anthropic_url
   - trellis model id routing: `codex:<slug>` ids → CodexBackend with slug after colon; yamlProviders() generates `${provider}:${model}` ids (collision: yaml provider named `codex` produces `codex:gpt-5.5[1m]` which routes to CodexBackend, NOT the anthropic proxy)
   - CPA (CLIProxyAPI, cpa.smokingmouse.cc): serves /v1/responses; does NOT recognize `[1m]` slugs; requires provider name != "OpenAI", requires_openai_auth=false (per workspace.md)
   - Progress protocol: sessions.md keeps last 5 (rotate oldest to archive.md in same write); README.md Current Focus bounded
